title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode9 I Want to Believe

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: BAD DOGS are totally lit again tonight! Are they seriously still in high school?!

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line: Akito's sheer power draws you in while Toya is great at the technical stuff. He's got a mysterious quality as well. I doubt any of the young groups around here can compete!

rows.Speaker: Spectator A
rows.Line: What about Ken's daughter?

rows.Speaker: Spectator B
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Man, what a great time to be alive!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Tsk. Doesn't anyone have anything better to talk about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong with you? What are you getting all pissed off about?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing. I'm just sick of everyone around here talking about Ken's daughter all the time, is all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi's?

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: That reminds me. I hear you're both performing in an event soon. It must be annoying having to be compared to some girl riding her father's coattails.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that event is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Actually, I'm looking forward to it.
We're going to crush them with our singing.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Crush them?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm going to show them what real talent is so they'll never make stupid jokes about surpassing RAD WEEKEND again.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Seriously?! That's great! Ken's girl will look like a snot-nosed brat compared to you two!

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: In that case, maybe I'll lend you guys a little support of my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Support?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong. This is our problem to deal with.

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Oh, don't worry about me. I won't do anything...too bad.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Here we are. I wonder where those two are right now. Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's pitch black. And am I shaking?
I wonder if the phone is in a bag or something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Would you like the equipment moved over here?

rows.Speaker: New Staff
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks for helping out, Akito, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Akito and Toya were the names of the other two! It sounds like they're close by.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They seem a bit busy today, though.
Maybe I should try again some other time.
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The big show is tomorrow!
Are you ready, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Thanks to you, I've been able to get a lot of practice singing in front of people. I-I think I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've explained how the event works and we've done everything we can, so let's give it our best tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. I'll do my best!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I said I'd be fine, but I'm still really nervous... I wonder if there will be a lot of scary-looking people at this event...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Isn't that that guy from before?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh. It was Azusawa, wasn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's right. Um, your name was Aoyagi, right?
Are you on your way to Weekend Garage?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I was on my way to the park nearby to practice. And I said it before, but there's no need to be so formal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... R-Right... Um, is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah. This is something I do on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My singing still isn't as good as Akito's when it comes to grabbing the attention of the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, can I ask you something?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, sure.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you really serious about holding an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ...What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please tell me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I guess...I want to...be serious about it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, I only just recently learned about that event, so I'm sure you probably think I'm not very serious about it, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The first time I saw An singing, my heart started racing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And my heart was thumping even harder the first time we sang together. I remember thinking, I never knew something could be so fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I've never really had a dream of my own like An, but now I feel like I want to sing with her and chase after her dream together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I still have a long way to go, but it makes me really happy to be able to work so hard toward something with her.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, and um... Thank you for inviting us to the event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you hadn't invited us, I think I probably would have been too scared to do something like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I'm going to give it my best tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...Right.
The day of the event
Kamiyama Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Over here! Hey, you got some new clothes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, um...didn't really know what I was looking for, so I had the staff help me pick it out. D-Do I look all right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. I think it suits you just great.
Oh, what if you tried wearing contacts next time?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Putting something in my eyes like that is a little scary...but maybe I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So you guys made it.
If you want, you can use the green room in the back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Gotcha. Thanks, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Um, I-I'm looking forward to tonight!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Same here. I know you're probably nervous, this being your first time and all, but good luck.

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Hehe. Kohane, you sound a bit nervous.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: W-Well, yeah... Just look at how many customers there are out front...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Look at 'em laughing like fools.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's go, Toya. It's time to crush them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, do you have a minute first?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm?
